entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-3hrh-pfw6-9m5x: Hono: Cookie helper does not sanitize sameSite and priority, allowing Set-Cookie injection

entry.title: [UPDATED] GHSA-f577-qrjj-4474: Hono: JWT middleware accepts any Authorization scheme, not only Bearer

Affected:

### Summary The `jwt` and `jwk` middlewares do not verify that the `Authorization` header value uses the`Bearer` scheme.
